title: SONATI: Spatio-temporal ocean neighbourhood asymmetric transformer for imputation of sparse, tabular data with uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2611.28270v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Missing value imputation is often a prerequisite for downstream analyses. In oceanography, observational data are frequently structured in a tabular manner, highly sparse and exhibit spatio-temporal structures that classical imputers such as k-nearest neighbours or MissForest are not suited to exploit. We present the Spatio-temporal Ocean Neighbourhood Asymmetric Transformer for Imputation (SONATI), a masked, factorised time-space transformer operating on pre-computed, local time and space neighbourhoods, which reduces computational complexity compared to global attention. SONATI is designed to work with tabular data and is thus in principle able to work on both gridded and unstructured data, though evaluation here was performed on gridded North Atlantic data only. It provides aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties through a negative log-likelihood loss and multiple forward passes with Monte Carlo dropout. Systematic ablations on attentio

translated_title: SONATI：用于稀疏表格数据带不确定性填补的时空海洋邻域非对称Transformer
translated_abstract: 缺失值填补往往是下游分析的先决条件。在海洋学中，观测数据通常以表格形式结构化，高度稀疏，并表现出经典填补方法（如k近邻或MissForest）难以利用的时空结构。我们提出了时空海洋邻域非对称Transformer填补方法（SONATI），这是一种掩码式、分解化的时空Transformer，运行在预先计算的局部时间和空间邻域上，与全局注意力机制相比降低了计算复杂度。SONATI专为表格数据设计，因此原则上既能处理网格化数据，也能处理非结构化数据，不过本文的评估仅在网格化的北大西洋数据上进行。该方法通过负对数似然损失和多次带蒙特卡洛dropout的前向传播，提供偶然不确定性和认知不确定性估计。对注意力的系统性消融实验...
tldr: SONATI是一种基于局部时空邻域的分解式掩码Transformer，能够高效填补高度稀疏的海洋观测表格数据，并同时提供偶然不确定性和认知不确定性估计。
en_tdlr: SONATI is a masked, factorised spatio-temporal transformer operating on pre-computed local neighbourhoods that efficiently imputes highly sparse oceanographic tabular data while providing both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty estimates.
